places.name: Bhavani Island
places.description: Bhavani Island is a riverside recreation destination on the Krishna River near Vijayawada.

places.name: Kanaka Durga Temple
places.description: Kanaka Durga Temple is a prominent temple on Indrakeeladri overlooking Vijayawada and the Krishna River.

places.name: Mogalarajapuram Caves
places.description: Mogalarajapuram Caves are rock-cut historic caves and an archaeological attraction in Vijayawada.
